## Reading notes (by hand, 2026-11-20 ~03:00 UTC; raw texts and outputs above)
- gen / fullgen (800 and 8,000): every failure read carries a margin of exactly +0.000 or a constant small value
  (+0.125): the " yes" and " no" logits are equal in bf16 on most inputs, so the prediction is a tie broken to "no" or
  a constant offset. Failures fall on positives and negatives alike and on candidates inside and outside table F: no
  shortcut is used and no hop is attempted; these fine-tunes carry no input-dependent signal (consistent with their
  training-subset accuracy of 0.50-0.54 and with exploratory 1).
- fullcls: margins are large (median |margin| 0.66) but uncorrelated with the label on test (train subset 0.72-0.76):
  it memorises part of the training split and does not generalise.
- scratch (seed 42, 1 failure of 500, #156): the scratchpad is right at every step (bridge 60, F3C, answer 1) and the
  last word is wrong ("no" with candidate 1 = answer 1): an error in the final comparison, not in a look-up.
- sweep (rho 0.55, measured same-symbol cosine 0.30): 148 of 150 failures have a broken hop; a broken chain gives a
  final score near 0, below the training threshold (0.056), so positives with a broken chain are answered "no" and
  negatives are answered correctly by default; 2 failures are threshold errors with both hops right.
